title: Reject unusable UIA navigation pane rectangles before area selection

scope.sourceDefect: Rect.Empty has negative-infinite dimensions. The original area comparator can select it because their product is positive infinity; a later physical-left comparison can then be vacuous.
scope.observedRunCause: Not established. The exact selected runtime IDs and measured pane bounds in the external completed0a2 run remain in its uninspected breadcrumb artifact.
scope.preserved: The original FindAll/BoundingRectangle reads, largest-area comparator, tie/order behavior, actions, assertion expressions, deadlines, LocalFree/SetContrast ownership, catch/finally and all other bytes remain unchanged.
scope.newQuery: The existing candidate's IsOffscreen property is read after the existing BoundingRectangle read unless Rect.Empty short-circuits the guard. No catch hides provider exceptions; no reacquisition or extra native action is added.
scope.visibleMeaning: UIA IsOffscreen is false; this is not proof of complete visual exposure or a unique native pane identity.
scope.geometry: X,Y,Width,Height,Right,Bottom and area must be finite; dimensions positive. Negative screen origins remain valid.

primarySources.supportedFact: Rect.Empty has positive-infinite X/Y and negative-infinite Width/Height.
IsOffscreen reports whether the UIA element is off the screen.

verification.scope: V8 source checks and independent IEEE-754 geometry model; no PowerShell parser, UIA, .NET or native execution
verification.runInstructions: Evaluate checkSource as JavaScript, then call reviewPaneSelectionGuard({before,after,edit:manifest.edits[0]}) with exact full source strings.

limitations: PowerShell syntax and actual UIA/native execution of this candidate have not run.
This guard does not choose between multiple finite visible elements sharing NYC-Tron.
The observed0a2 failure is not retrospectively assigned a selector cause.
Separate fixed-checkpoint and possible GET-ownership changes are not part of this candidate.
application: Require exact preimage; replace the one before span with after. Reversing the one after span must restore every byte of cb69.
